question: Rural Employment Generation Programme (REGP) was launched in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1995.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Rural Employment Generation Programme **(REGP) was launched in** 1995** by the Indian Government.
 
• The aim of the program was to create **employment opportunities** in rural areas.
